question.en: Which area does the BenchCouncil annual table assign to Classifier-free guidance?
question.zh: BenchCouncil 年度表把 Classifier-free guidance 归入哪个领域？

explanation.en: Classifier-free guidance appears in the Diffusion Model Application area of the official annual table.
explanation.zh: Classifier-free guidance 位于官方年度表的“扩散模型应用”领域。
